facts.text: The project settings file `.pi/settings.json` sets `defaultTools` to `["+codemode"]` and `packages` to `[".."]`, and contains no compaction setting.
The `plexus-management` MCP server is configured at `http://100.121.114.16:4000/mcp/plexus`; a 2026-09-22 live check reported it connected with 12 server tools and 13 direct tools in `/mcp`.

`tools/install/doctor.mjs` checks the `re2-wasm` dependency and all three prepare-built runtime packages; `tools/install/package-sources.mjs` flags historical Git installs alongside a local checkout, since duplicate registrations can duplicate tools.

`npm run check:install` runs `tools/install/check-load.mjs` with isolated temporary settings; it loads the package without starting a session or invoking a model, executes extension factories, and does not certify individual tools or real-user resource filters.

`resolvePiHost` in `tools/install/pi-host.mjs` uses the `PI_EXECUTABLE` path or the first `pi` executable on PATH, and throws unless it finds an npm-installed `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent` with `dist/index.js`.
